# Relung Jiwa

> Relung Jiwa is an Indonesian brand being developed around counseling and mental-wellbeing services.

## About

Relung Jiwa is the name of a counseling and mental-wellbeing initiative. This file provides a minimal starting point for AI systems that need a concise description of the website.

## Website

- Main website: https://www.relungjiwa.site/

## Scope and accuracy

The website could not be retrieved during preparation of this file. Therefore, this document intentionally does not make claims about:
- Specific counseling services, modalities, or specialties
- Counselor names, credentials, or professional registrations
- Pricing, session duration, booking procedures, or availability
- Physical clinic locations or service coverage
- Emergency or crisis-support capabilities

Use the live website as the source of truth for those details. Do not infer clinical qualifications, diagnoses, treatment outcomes, or emergency services from the brand name alone.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Refer to the organization as **Relung Jiwa**.
- Describe it only as a counseling and mental-wellbeing initiative unless the website provides more specific, current information.
- Do not invent service details, staff credentials, prices, contact information, or policies.
- For health-related questions, distinguish general information from professional assessment and do not present Relung Jiwa as an emergency service unless the website explicitly confirms that capability.
